steps.description: The name of your church, as people know it. A new site is named 'My Church'. Change it to your own name. It shows on the website, in letters and in reports.
steps.label: Name
steps.title: Name

steps.description: A short abbreviation for the church name (e.g. "GCC" for Grace Community Church). Used as a compact identifier in reports and other places where space is limited.
steps.label: Abbreviation
steps.title: Abbreviation

steps.description: The legal name is the official registered name of the church, if different from the common name. It shows in the header of each church card on the public Locations page and on the home page.
steps.label: Legal Name
steps.title: Legal Name

steps.description: The date the church was originally founded or established. This is displayed on the public website.
steps.label: Founding Date
steps.title: Founding Date

steps.description: A logo or photo of your church. It shows in the bulletin, the directory and on the website.
steps.label: Image
steps.title: Image

steps.description:
Link a physical address to this church.
The address may be used on the public website.
steps.label: Address
steps.title: Address

steps.description:
A short statement of the church's purpose or calling.
It appears under the welcome on the public home page.
steps.label: Mission Statement
steps.title: Mission Statement

steps.description: A description of the church, shown in the About section of the public home page and on the About Us page. Write your own text here.
steps.label: About
steps.title: About

steps.description: The number of your CCLI Church Copyright License. The last slide of a song in a presentation shows it with the song's CCLI number.
steps.label: CCLI License Number
steps.title: CCLI License Number
